The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The mechanism involves the targeting of ribosomal proteins and their subsequent modulation of Kallikrein 4, which may have implications for cellular processes such as inflammation and cell proliferation.
